description: Eight-step rhythm generator: each step lasts for a time of its own and fires a chosen number of gates while it lasts, free running or counting an external clock

params.text: Sets how long that step lasts, as a percentage of the global rate
Sets how many gates that step fires, 1 to 32, spread evenly across the length of the step
Sets how long each of that step's gates stays high, as a percentage of the space between them
Sets how long a step of full length lasts, in decades from 0.01 seconds to 10000 seconds; with a clock patched, step lengths count clock pulses instead of seconds
Steps the sequence direction on to the next of forward, reverse, bouncing and random

inputs.text: Adds to the length of that step, a tenth of the slider's range per volt
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the number of gates a step fires comes from that step's knob alone, despite the panel drawing an arrow from the jack into the knob
A rising edge advances the count, and patching anything here makes step and gate lengths count clock pulses rather than seconds
A rising edge sends the sequence back to its first step and restarts its timing
A rising edge runs or stops the sequence
A rising edge steps the sequence direction on to the next of forward, reverse, bouncing and random

outputs.text: Carries the 10V gates of that step while the sequence is on it, and 0V the rest of the time
Carries the gates of whichever step the sequence is on, at 10V

notes: The sequence is running as soon as the module is placed, and free runs in seconds until a clock is patched, after which step and gate lengths count clock pulses.
